label: Payment request
coverage: Approval status is separate from bank settlement. Writes and approval logs are separate calls; not a complete field-change journal. No universal approved-reversal object located.

label: Reimbursement estimate / pre-request
coverage: Pre-request history is thinner than claim history. Withdrawn or returned transitions need explicit events, not inference from last update.

label: Reimbursement bill claim
coverage: Keep claim and payment stages distinct. Payment-sync events can carry generic Payments actor rather than the actual processor.

label: People pay advance
coverage: Approval, disbursement and full recovery are different milestones. Count-based numbering needs concurrency verification.

label: Ops / DropX One advance request
coverage: Decision action does not persist decision actor or append a business event. Do not merge with hr_pay_advance_requests by amount/name.

label: Recruiter field travel reimbursement
coverage: Do not create a duplicate root payment. Client retry ID is not the canonical payment ID.

label: Workforce payroll run and Finance handoff
coverage: One run has many payments. A partially paid run must not be shown as wholly complete. Guard forbids rewriting paid status/reference without a separate approved reversal.

label: People payroll run / adjustments
coverage: Snapshot generations and revisions must remain traceable. Payroll approval is not proof of a bank payment.

label: Workforce payout publication
coverage: Notification success and business approval are distinct. Preserve old revisions after recalculation.

label: Workforce payout dispute
coverage: Messages are evidence but not always a structured before/after event. Initial One event may have a worker name but no auth actor id.

label: Workforce payout correction
coverage: Approved does not mean applied. Tracker must test correction_id in calculation snapshots.

label: Workforce earning / deduction adjustment
coverage: Generic adjustment row is not a complete immutable lifecycle history. Preserve rejected/reversed versions.

label: Station loss claim
coverage: Loss report and applied salary deduction are different facts.

label: Mileage claim
coverage: Mileage evidence reference cannot be treated as global unique request ID.

label: Workforce payment hold / release
coverage: Same reference may exist for another worker. Capture every release request and denied release attempt separately.

label: People salary hold / cancellation
coverage: Separate namespace and ownership from Workforce hold; append a complete transition log.

label: Leave request
coverage: History must preserve cancellations, changes and applied attendance, not only approval status.

label: Attendance regularization / manual punch
coverage: Several portals write this shared table. Distinguish request_kind, origin, actual punch and requested correction.

label: Work-from-home request
coverage: Approved date range may contain skipped holidays/punches; show per-date effect.

label: Business trip / site visit request
coverage: Portal label Business trip maps to site_visit storage; alias both names.

label: Weekly roster plan / recall / resubmission
coverage: Steps can be deleted and rebuilt on recall/resubmit. Include approval_history so prior cycles do not disappear.

label: Shift swap request
coverage: Two-party request; do not report only the requester as the next actor.

label: Employee document request
coverage: Older hr_note was a mutable field; backfilled messages are reconstructed history, not original author-proof events.

label: Exit / resignation / withdrawal
coverage: Approval, access cutoff, clearance, settlement and closed case are distinct milestones.

label: Suspension / restoration / access reconciliation
coverage: Business effective date differs from recorded time; human initiator can differ from worker executing the change.

label: Connect Centre case / protected report
coverage: Admin tracker must preserve protected identity and private attachment permissions.

label: Unplanned leave case
coverage: Detection is a system event, not a submitted employee request.

label: Associate registration and joining
coverage: Person identifier is not a request identifier. Correlate through explicit intake/source links; never by name alone.

label: Associate exit / lifecycle case
coverage: Legacy field names differ from canonical Workforce cutover; verify deployed column set.

label: Provider / Amazon invitation request
coverage: Sent invitation is not completed provider activation. Preserve every attempt and provider response.

label: Refer-and-earn referral
coverage: Do not equate qualified or approved with paid; validate reward link and payout evidence.

label: Associate Connect support request
coverage: Update action overwrites note and has no recorded responder actor or appended event; old conversation cannot be reconstructed from this row.

label: Recruitment lead / candidate
coverage: System Logs intentionally hides some system events; central tracker must read full evidence and retain source identity.

label: Job application and People handoff
coverage: The candidate record and employment record remain different entities; join the explicit transfer fields.

label: Hiring requisition
coverage: Closing requisition does not close all related applications; retain separate states.

label: Advertising request / external publication
coverage: History is a mutable JSON array updated in application code. A database edit can bypass it; concurrent writes can replace entries.

label: Workforce profile change request
coverage: Do not apply approval automatically in tracker; preserve old proposed versions and canonical person mapping.

label: Operational performance review
coverage: Import source date differs from event time. Proxy identity and bypass reason must survive role/name changes.

label: Operational follow-up action
coverage: Action number is not globally unique; label-only owners need a durable actor/person mapping.

label: COD proof / exception / reconciliation
coverage: A daily station record is not a payment request. External worker outcomes need explicit correlation and attempt history.

label: Company asset audit
coverage: Asset ID/tag is an entity alias, not the audit case ID; retain each audit session.

label: Vehicle audit and findings
coverage: An audit document is not itself an immutable change journal; inspected schema needs event-coverage hardening.

label: Vehicle service / maintenance record
coverage: Historical service rows do not prove every edit/reversal was logged. Do not infer payment link from matching amount or date.

label: Mailbox / identity job
coverage: Audit insert helper ignores returned error. Service-account updates require both initiator and executor attribution.

label: Report import batch
coverage: A successful upload is not necessarily a successful downstream recalculation; log dependency completion.

label: External connector run
coverage: External console changes cannot be inferred from internal logs; record provider receipt/time separately.

label: EDD / review-source refresh job
coverage: Mutable queue state is not a full per-attempt log. No company_id in this creation schema: resolve tenant through an authoritative station mapping before exposing a job.

label: Finance policy / rent changes
coverage: Track configuration changes as related events; do not retroactively rewrite original policy snapshots.

label: Designation / access / routing changes
coverage: Do not substitute current role/name for historical actor role. Portal grants and People identity are different authorities.
